title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Fragmentation Using Opentrons OT-2
author: Amy Denton
materials: After selecting your protocol, choose ‘Start setup’:
For the ‘choose robot step’, select the OT-2.
Switch off the Opentrons® OT-2 robot.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer DNA samples into a 2 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher plate, ensuring no more than 3000 ng of DNA is transferred per well.

substeps.instruction: Mix each sample by pipetting carefully with a wide-bore pipette tip prior to transfer.
Calculate the volume required for 3000 ng of DNA and round down to the nearest whole microliter (e.g., if 24.8 µL is needed, transfer 24 µL) to avoid under-shearing.
Transfer the volume (up to a maximum of 300 µL) into the plate using a wide-bore pipette tip.
Load samples down each column of the plate (e.g., sample one in A1, sample two in B1, sample three in C1, etc.).

steps.title: Dilute DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Top-up each sample in the KingFisher plate to a final volume of 300 µL using buffer EB.

steps.title: Label Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Label the plate containing the diluted DNA samples as the 'Sample Plate'.

steps.title: Configure Opentrons OT-2 Software
steps.instruction: Set up the shearing protocol using the Opentrons® app on a laptop.

substeps.instruction: Open the Opentrons® app and verify the OT-2 is connected via the 'Devices' menu.
Select the appropriate shearing protocol from 'Protocols' based on the number of samples and their locations in the KingFisher plate.
Perform required calibration and offset measurements in the protocol window.

steps.title: Load OT-2 Deck
steps.instruction: Load the required labware onto the OT-2 deck according to the 'Labware & Liquids' map view.

substeps.instruction: Load the Sample Plate into slot 1.
Load the tip box into slot 2, ensuring tips are loaded so the robot takes from the first row.
Remove the lid of the tip box.

steps.title: Final Hardware Check
steps.instruction: Perform final checks on the OT-2 hardware before starting the run.

substeps.instruction: Check the OT-2 bin and empty it if required to prevent overflow.

steps.title: Execute Shearing Protocol
steps.instruction: Start and monitor the automated shearing process.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Start run' in the Opentrons® app.
Visually confirm that the robot loads all tips and that pipettes are drawing up liquid.
Monitor the run, especially during transition periods between columns, to ensure tip disposal and attachment of new tips occur without issue (each column takes approximately 45 mins).

steps.title: Post-Shearing Processing
steps.instruction: Remove the Sample Plate from the OT-2 once the program is complete.

substeps.instruction: Either proceed to automated SPRI clean-up on the KingFisher Apex (per Sanger Tree of Life Fragmented DNA clean up: Automated SPRI protocol v2) or store samples at 4 °C.
If storing at 4 °C, ensure the plate is sealed properly to prevent evaporation.
